name: usage-overlay
notes: A PERSISTENT (non-modal) panel drawn above the base chrome but below every overlay, so any modal correctly occludes it — that z-order relationship is the whole reason it has its own scenario. Asserted via the new top-level `usage_overlay` key for the same reason as debug-overlay: it is not a modal, so putting it in overlay_flags() would corrupt any_modal_open. The prior needles were 'Usage' and 'Cost'; the render emits ' F8 · usage ' and ' cost ' (lowercase), so both were mis-cased.
